issues.legal_issue: The power of attorney authorized its holder to execute and register sale deeds and receive consideration, while the clause permitting presentation of deeds signed by the principals was additional and did not restrict that authority.
The alleged sale transaction involving property situated and executed in Dehradun gave rise to no cause of action in Buxar against the purchaser.

Criminal proceedings arising from the sale could not be maintained against the purchaser, who paid consideration and had no role in executing the power of attorney or any alleged misconduct by its holder.
